# Pixel Isolate AI Background Remover Engine

> Pixel Isolate is a high-resolution, browser-based AI background remover engine engineered for subpixel subject isolation, HSV color keying, and bulk background extraction.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Neural Segmentation**: Browser-based WebAssembly subject isolation preserving hair, fur, and delicate edges.
- **Chroma Keying**: Interactive HSV color keying for green screen and custom backdrop removal.
- **Bulk Batch Processing**: Parallel multi-image extraction for print-on-demand and e-commerce workflows.
- **Solid Canvas Backdrops**: Apply marketplace-compliant white (#FFFFFF), black, or custom solid color backgrounds.
